# Resource: widget_settings

The account's settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "widget_gadget" "main" {
  name = "Main"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `theme` - (Required) The theme.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports no additional attributes.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a widget settings using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = widget_settings.example
  id = "default"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import a widget settings using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import widget_settings.example default
```
